intro: They are found typically in late summer, and early fall in increased populations, known as blooms. This is due to higher temperatures and other environmental factors such as wind. R. pulmo is common in the Irish Sea, and is typically up to 40 cm (16 in) in diameter, but can exceptionally reach 150 cm (59 in) in length or larger,making it the largest jellyfish in British and Irish waters. (Cyanea capillata, the Lion's Mane jellyfish, reaches an even larger size, but is generally smaller in Britain). The species can grow up to one meter (3.2 feet) and weigh up to 25 kilograms (55 lbs). Rhizostoma pulmo is moderately venomous compared to other species.
